scientific_limitations: Only finite sums of weighted-composition operators with pairwise distinct unitary-affine symbols on the standard Gaussian Hilbert Fock space in at least two complex variables. The proof is direct, with no one-variable finite-sum result as an input. Only a universal sharp lower Calkin estimate is claimed, not equality for each sum or results for nonunitary symbols.
title: Multivariable Weyl-sum rigidity and an optimal coefficient-energy Calkin gap
